description: This file defines a UI component class for the Mobile Security section in the Mattermost system console, including panels for general mobile security settings and Microsoft Intune integration, with methods for interaction and visibility checks.

classes.name: MobileSecurity
classes.description: Main class representing the Mobile Security section in the system console UI, providing access to panels and actions.

classes.name: GeneralMobileSecurityPanel
classes.description: Panel class for general mobile security settings within the Mobile Security section.

classes.name: MicrosoftIntunePanel
classes.description: Panel class for Microsoft Intune settings within the Mobile Security section.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the Mobile Security section and its header are visible.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the save button to apply changes.
